newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar mostly higher in lacklustre trad.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar mostly higher in lacklustre trad.

text.p: White sugar futures hovered in their earlier ranges on Thursday afternoon, reluctant to spring into life before the March raws expiry and reflecting a lacklustre raws performance, traders said.

The May/August spread accounted for much of the thin volume, accompanied by light trade selling at the higher end of the ranges. May/August remained tight and narrowed back to even money after the 50 cents seen at the open.
Traders said the dull activity in London would probably pickup after New York's spot March contract goes off the board at close of business on Friday.
At 1710 GMT May was up $1.20 at $307.30 and August up 70 cents at $306.90. Volume reached just 712 lots.

In physical news, Syria bought 13,000 tonnes of raws at $296.60 per tonne from Lorico, for delivery in April. Syria cancelled another tender cto buy 13,000 tonnes of whites as price offers did not meet conditions.
Paris values were also trapped in tight ranges with only the two front months traded in a volume of 423 lots.
May was unchanged at $306.00 and August up 60 cents at $306.50.
